# Apiframe

Apiframe provides one API for generating and managing AI images, videos, music, uploads, assets, jobs, and custom LoRAs.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/apiframe/.

## Actions

- **Generate Image**: Submit a paid image generation job that consumes Apiframe credits based on the selected model and controls.
- **Generate Music**: Submit a paid music generation job that consumes Apiframe credits, with cost and output count varying by model.
- **Generate Video**: Submit a paid video generation job that consumes Apiframe credits based on the selected model and controls.
- **Get Account** (read-only): Return the authenticated Apiframe user, team plan and credit balance, role, and active API-key metadata.
- **Get Job** (read-only): Get the current status, progress, provider-specific result, cost, and error details for one Apiframe generation job.
- **List Jobs** (read-only): Return one page of generation jobs, optionally filtered by status, model, job ID, or ownership scope.
